bug_info.bug_desc: In csrng_env_pkg, the ZERO_SEED_GENBITS parameter encoded the least-significant 32-bit word as 0x7 instead of the specified 0x4. Any DV sequence using ZERO_SEED_GENBITS to create a known deterministic seed would produce the wrong pattern, causing mismatched expected values in testbench flows that rely on this constant.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the least-significant 32-bit word of ZERO_SEED_GENBITS from 32'h7 to 32'h4 so the constant matches the required zero-seed generation pattern: all zeros except the least-significant word equal to 0x00000004.

bug_info.bug_desc: In csrng_ctr_drbg_cmd, a generate command with all-zero additional data was not handled as a no-update command. The old command FIFO pop gated on upd_cmd_rdy_i, cmd_upd_req_o was asserted whenever the command FIFO was non-empty, the rcstage waited for upd_cmd_ack_i, and the final key/V were taken from the update outputs. For a zero-additional-data generate this performs an unwanted DRBG update and returns the post-update key/V instead of the current key/V/reseed counter unchanged, violating the CTR_DRBG generate specification. The fix detects the zero-adata generate condition, latches it as gen_adata_null_q, suppresses the update request, pops the staging FIFOs using the bypass indication instead of the update ack, and stores the pre-update key/V/instance in the widened rcstage FIFO so the final response can use those unchanged values.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add combinational detection of a GEN command whose additional data is all zeros, hold it in a flop across the pipeline stages, gate cmd_upd_req_o for that case, allow the command FIFO and rcstage FIFO to advance without update handshakes, and select the stored pre-update key/V/instance data for the final key/VRC FIFO instead of the update block outputs when the bypass flag is set.

bug_info.bug_desc: In csrng_ctr_drbg_gen, the adstage FIFO was pushed in the ReqIdle FSM state on the same cycle as v_ctr_load, and its write data used genreq_v. At that point the incremented V counter has not yet been captured into v_ctr_q, so the stored adstage_v is the un-incremented incoming V. The block-encryption phase uses v_sized with the incremented counter, but the later update request uses adstage_v. This makes the DRBG update use a different V than the V used for the encryption phase. The fix moves the adstage push into ReqSend and writes v_sized into the adstage FIFO so the update uses the same incremented V as the block encryption.
bug_info.fix_hint: Delay the adstage FIFO write until the ReqSend state when the block-encryption request is active, and capture v_sized (the V value actually used for block encryption) in the FIFO rather than the raw genreq_v. This ensures adstage_v matches the encryption V used by the subsequent update.

bug_info.bug_desc: In csrng_state_db, the combinational instance_status signal was asserted only for INS, RES, and UPD command codes, omitting GEN. When a generate write is processed, the active/status bit stored for the DRBG instance is therefore cleared instead of being set or maintained, so an instantiated instance can appear inactive after a generate. The spec requires generate commands to set the active/status bit just like instantiate, reseed, and update commands.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add the missing condition to the instance_status assignment: treat state_db_wr_ccmd_i == GEN the same as INS, RES, and UPD so that a generate write stores the active/status bit as 1.
